_doc: Hoa Cái Đường lineage (rules-proposals R5). Re-leaned Fire, Earth -> Earth, Metal: the seat (565) is Earth 37 %, Metal 25 %, Fire 12 %, and Fire fails in any order. The Hall's alchemy is mineral alchemy (ngoại đan): cinnabar, mercury, sulphur and lead are Earth and Metal, and the fire belongs to the furnace's coal, not the alchemist. Outer gate: cinnabar-washing-primer (proposal, Yellow). Inner gate and above: canopy-furnace-canon (proposal, Profound, Earth). Secret: nine-cycle-mercury-art (proposal, inner gate). Body: sulphur-lung-breath (proposal, element-free; every member learns it first). Unpriced.

secret.note: the mercury refining; taught only after the Sulphur Lung Breath is at its fourth layer

lineage.tree_route_note: The Canopy's road: Clay Furnace for the body as the furnace (fire resistance, health), Earthen Gate for the heavy lid that takes blows (block, health), Watching the Fire across the border for the pill house's alchemy.

techniques.name: Cinnabar-Washing Primer (Đào Sa Quyết)
techniques.concept: The outer gate's method, learned at the washing troughs: the disciple rocks the ore pan and breathes with it, drawing Earth from the red clay or Metal from the heavy grains that sink. In a fight it is a heavy, grinding method that wears the foe down.

arts.concept: A sweeping strike that throws heavy grit: deals Earth damage and lowers the foe's speed for a few seconds; repeated hits deepen the slow.

techniques.lore: Written by the founder Úy Đan Dương for the washers he hired from the badland diggings in 1060 (V117).

techniques.name: Canopy Furnace Canon (Hoa Cái Lô Kinh)
techniques.concept: Named for the Canopy (Hoa Cái), the asterism that spreads over the pole star. The cultivator makes their body the furnace's lid, a heavy Earth canopy over the dantian, so that what is refined inside cannot escape. In a fight the holder takes blows on the canopy and returns them as pressure, and their poisons and debuffs on a foe stay sealed in longer.

arts.concept: Raises an Earth ward over the holder; while it holds, debuffs the holder has laid on foes do not fade.
Breaks the ward outward: every foe near the holder takes Earth damage that grows with the debuffs on them.

A puff of censer smoke: a small Chaos hit. If a pill is prepared in your pill slot, the censer burns it: you get its effect at half strength, and the foe takes a cloud of 4 debuff stacks per pill grade, for 6 s, of the pill's element (Fire Burn, Wood Poison, Water or Ice the Ice stacks, Metal, Earth, Thunder and Wind their own; a pill with no element smokes as Poison). A pill that would fail gives you nothing, but its smoke lays in full. With no pill it is only the puff.

techniques.lore: The founder's canon, written in his first year at the Hall. The furnace sits under a painted canopy of nine stars in the Hall's refining room, and the disciples cultivate beneath it.

techniques.name: Nine-Cycle Mercury Art (Cửu Chuyển Hống Pháp)
techniques.concept: The refining of mercury from cinnabar, nine times turned, which the old alchemists said makes an elixir of long life and which mostly makes poison. The art teaches the refiner to steer the mercury's Metal qi with their own. In a fight it coats the holder's strikes with quicksilver that seeps into a foe and stacks.

arts.concept: For a few seconds the holder's hits apply a Mercury stack; at nine stacks the foe's healing is cut sharply and they take Metal damage over time.

techniques.lore: Taught only after the Sulphur Lung Breath, because the co-founder Tôn Luyện Hà learned it first and died of it in 1141.

techniques.name: Sulphur Lung Breath (Hoàng Phế Tức)
techniques.concept: A body art, element-free, that hardens the lungs, liver and skin against the fumes of cinnabar, mercury and sulphur. Every member of the Hall learns it before anything else. In a fight it gives resistance to poison and lets the holder breathe through their own poison clouds.

arts.concept: For a few seconds the holder is immune to poison and burning and regains health for every poison stack on foes nearby.

techniques.lore: Made by the founder after Tôn Luyện Hà's death in 1141, from the breathing of the Lưu Hoàng sulphur miners, who live to be old in air that kills a horse.
